decisions.statement: A device secret represents the account the device secret was minted for.
A device secret opens everything that account opens and nothing more.
One hash sits on one device secret.
A revoked device secret opens nothing.
A device secret is reached by the person with the device secret and the device the secret names.
The secret a device presents exists nowhere here.
A device secret last presented is said nowhere.

definition: the credential one device presents in place of a session
